mapper.sql: SELECT exam_id, paper_id, exam_name, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, proctor_id, status, anti_cheat_settings, extra_info, created_at, updated_at FROM exam
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam (paper_id, exam_name, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, proctor_id, status, anti_cheat_settings, extra_info) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{examName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMinutes}, #{proctorId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'Pending'), #{antiCheatSettings}, #{extraInfo})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam SET paper_id = #{paperId}, exam_name = #{examName}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, proctor_id = #{proctorId}, status = #{status}, anti_cheat_settings = #{antiCheatSettings}, extra_info = #{extraInfo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
UPDATE exam SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE exam_id = #{id}
